reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
Video games, despite having some benefits, can also cause some problems for people who play them. This essay will, accordingly, provide some ideas about the advantages and disadvantages of video games and explain why I believe that the drawbacks are greater than the benefits.

This situation has given rise to some benefits for players, especially young people. Firstly, video games can be a good way to relax after studying or working. People can have fun and reduce stress when they play games in their free time. Secondly, some games require players to think carefully and solve different problems. As a result, players may improve their thinking and problem-solving skills. Some educational games can also help children learn new things in an enjoyable way. Therefore, video games can be useful if people play them for a suitable amount of time.

However, video games can also have several negative effects. The main problem is that people may spend too much time playing them. As a result, students may have less time for studying, sleeping and doing exercise. This can lead to worse school results and an unhealthy lifestyle. In addition, people who spend many hours playing games may have less time to talk to their family and friends. Consequently, their relationships with other people may become weaker. Therefore, the disadvantages of playing video games too much can be more serious than the benefits.

In conclusion, video games can help people relax and improve some useful skills. However, playing them for too long can have negative effects on study, health and relationships. Therefore, I believe that the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits when people do not control their playing time.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
Although video games can provide entertainment and some educational benefits, they may also cause serious harm to their users. I am firmly convinced that the harmful effects of video games outweigh their advantages.

Admittedly, gaming can offer several benefits in terms of entertainment and education. Players can be transported into a virtual world where they are able to race, shoot, or perform other activities that are impossible in real life, thereby enjoying novelty and excitement. In addition, they often have to think of strategies in order to win; as a result, problem-solving, teamwork, and decision-making skills can be developed. However, these gains are relatively insignificant because such abilities can also be developed through healthier alternatives, such as team sports or debate clubs. These activities can provide further benefits without exposing young people to the same risks of addiction and physical inactivity.

Nevertheless, the negative effects of gaming are more serious. Video games can be highly addictive because players are frequently given scores, new targets, and rewards, which make them feel that they are achieving something. This sense of achievement and competition may cause children to spend hours trying to progress through game levels or gain a higher score than their friends. As a result, they can become addicted to gaming, leading to a lack of sleep, poorer eyesight, a sedentary lifestyle, and problems at school. Homework is often sacrificed for a few more hours on gaming consoles.

In conclusion, although video games can entertain players and help them develop certain skills, these benefits can be obtained through safer activities. I am firmly convinced that the drawbacks of excessive gaming outweigh its benefits because addiction can damage young people's health and education.

reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
The development of technology and transportation has made it easier for scientists and tourists to visit remote natural areas, such as the South Pole. This development can bring some benefits, but it can also cause problems for the environment. This essay will, accordingly, discuss both the positive and negative effects of this trend.

This situation has given rise to some positive effects. Firstly, scientists can travel to these areas more easily to study nature and animals. They can collect important information about climate change and the environment. As a result, people can understand these places better and find ways to protect them. Secondly, tourism can bring money to local areas. More tourists may spend money on hotels, food and transportation. Consequently, local people can have more jobs and income. Therefore, travelling to remote areas can bring benefits to both science and local communities.

However, this development can also have some negative effects. The main problem is that too many tourists may damage the natural environment. For example, visitors may leave rubbish or disturb animals. As a result, animals may lose their natural habitats and the area may become less clean. In addition, more people travelling to these places means more vehicles and transportation. This can increase pollution and have a negative effect on nature. Therefore, travelling to remote areas without proper control can cause serious environmental problems.

To address this issue, several measures can be taken. Governments should limit the number of tourists who can visit these areas. They should also make clear rules about protecting the environment. For example, visitors should not leave rubbish or disturb animals. In this way, people can enjoy these places while protecting them at the same time.

In conclusion, travelling to remote natural areas can provide benefits for scientific research and local people. However, it may also damage the environment if there are too many visitors. Therefore, I believe that this is a positive development if it is properly controlled.
reviews.overall: Cô thấy em viết đủ độ dài, câu khá rõ và có dùng được các nối ý như “As a result” và “Consequently”. Tuy nhiên, em đã biến đề thành bài nêu cả lợi lẫn hại, trong khi dàn ý giao yêu cầu khẳng định đây là phát triển có lợi với một đoạn cho khách du lịch và một đoạn cho nhà khoa học. Em cần viết lại đúng hai chuỗi ý Cô giao, nhất là lợi ích khoa học và ví dụ virus, nóng lên toàn cầu. Khi sửa, hãy dùng thêm câu bị động phù hợp trong hai body thay vì chủ yếu dùng câu chủ động đơn giản.

When these phenomena are studied more closely, scientists can be better prepared for potential outbreaks that may kill millions of people. Damaged habitats can also be restored more effectively.

In conclusion, easier access to remote natural areas is a positive development. It allows tourists to gain unique experiences while enabling scientists to understand important natural phenomena and respond to future challenges more effectively.

reviews.question: If a product is good or meets people’s needs, they will buy it. Therefore, advertising is unnecessary and no more than entertainment. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, advertising plays an important role in introducing products to customers. Some people believe that if a product is good or meets people’s needs, people will buy it without advertising. This essay will discuss why advertising is still necessary, although product quality is also important.

This situation has given rise to several opinions about the role of advertising. To begin with, a good product can attract customers because of its quality. If people have a good experience with a product, they may recommend it to their friends or family. Accordingly, the product can become popular without spending too much money on advertisements. For example, a restaurant with good food and reasonable prices can get more customers through positive reviews. Additionally, customers nowadays can easily find information about products on social media and websites.

However, I believe that advertising is still necessary for businesses. Firstly, advertisements help customers know about new products. For instance, when a company introduces a new phone, advertisements can show its design, functions and price. Without advertising, many customers may not know that the product exists. Another important point is that advertising helps companies compete with other businesses. A good product may not be successful if customers do not know about it.

To address this issue, companies should provide honest and useful information in their advertisements. Customers should also compare different products before buying them.

In conclusion, although a good product can attract customers through its quality, I disagree that advertising is unnecessary. It can provide information and help businesses reach more customers, so it is more than just entertainment.
reviews.overall: Em viết đúng hướng không đồng ý và giải thích được rằng chất lượng tốt có thể tạo lời giới thiệu, còn quảng cáo giúp khách biết đến sản phẩm. Tuy nhiên, Body 2 mới dừng ở ý nhận biết và cạnh tranh: em chưa giải thích cách quảng cáo tạo thương hiệu dễ nhớ, chưa đưa ví dụ công ty toàn cầu và chưa nêu rằng quảng cáo không thay thế được chất lượng. reviews.suggestedRevision:
Nowadays, some argue that good products will be purchased whenever they meet customers’ needs, making advertising unnecessary and merely entertaining. I am firmly convinced that advertising remains necessary, although product quality is crucial.

Admittedly, a product’s ability to meet customers’ needs and maintain quality standards is vital to its success. When customers have a good experience, they may recommend the product to friends and family. Such word-of-mouth publicity is often more credible than traditional advertising. For example, a local restaurant offering good food can gain customers through positive reviews and the organic growth of its customer base without investing heavily in advertising campaigns.

However, the necessity of advertising cannot be completely dismissed. As the number of products and services on the market grows, companies need to distinguish their offerings from those of competitors and make potential customers aware of them. Through advertising, more people can be reached and a memorable brand identity can be established, helping businesses stay ahead of their rivals. This can be seen in the way even leading global firms continue to advertise on multiple platforms to maintain their market presence. Without advertising, even a good product may fail to reach a wide market; without genuine quality, advertising alone cannot ensure long-term success.

In conclusion, while a good product can attract customers through its quality and recommendations, I disagree that advertising is unnecessary or simply entertainment. Businesses need both advertising to reach customers and genuine quality to retain them.

reviews.question:
Today, the high sales of popular consumer goods reflect the power of advertising and not the real needs of the society in which they are sold.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, many popular consumer goods are sold in large numbers. Some people believe that these high sales mainly show the power of advertising rather than the real needs of society. This essay will discuss how advertising affects customers and why other factors should also be considered.

This situation has given rise to several concerns about the influence of advertising. Firstly, advertisements can make people interested in products that they may not really need. Companies often use attractive pictures, special offers and famous people to attract customers. Accordingly, people may buy new clothes, phones or other products because they see them many times on social media. For example, a person may already have a good smartphone but decide to buy a new one after watching advertisements about its modern design and new functions. Additionally, advertisements can make popular products seem more necessary than they really are.

However, I do not completely agree that high sales only reflect the power of advertising. To begin with, people still buy many products because they have real needs. Food, clothes, school supplies and phones, for example, are necessary for daily life. Another important point is that product quality and price can also affect sales. If a product has poor quality or is too expensive, customers may not buy it again even if it is advertised frequently. Therefore, high sales can be caused by both advertising and real consumer needs.

To address this issue, customers should think carefully before buying popular products. They can compare prices, read reviews and consider whether the product is really necessary.

In conclusion, advertising has a strong influence on consumer behaviour, but it is not the only reason for high sales. Real needs, price and product quality also play important roles.

For example, when people want to buy a new phone, they can watch reviews on YouTube or read comments from other users. Additionally, consumers have become more familiar with advertising techniques. They know that companies often use attractive pictures, famous people and special offers to encourage customers to buy their products. Therefore, they may be more careful when seeing advertisements.

In my opinion, this is a positive development because it can help people make better buying decisions. Another important point is that customers may spend less money on unnecessary products. If they check different sources before buying something, they can choose a product that is more suitable for their needs and budget. Moreover, companies may need to improve their products instead of only depending on advertisements to attract customers.

To address this issue, consumers should continue to compare information from different sources before making a purchase. At the same time, companies should provide honest information about their products.

In conclusion, consumers are less influenced by advertising because they have more information and understand advertising methods better. I believe this is a positive development as it can help people make more careful and suitable choices.

reviews.question:
Online shopping is increasing dramatically.
How could this trend affect our environment and the kinds of jobs required?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, online shopping is becoming increasingly popular and has changed the way people purchase goods. Despite the undeniable benefits, this trend may lead to several undesirable effects on the environment and changes in the kinds of jobs required. This essay accordingly provides insights into these impacts.

This situation has given rise to several pressing consequences for the environment. Firstly, the development of online shopping can lead to a large amount of packaging waste. Products are often packed in boxes, plastic bags and other materials before being delivered to customers. Accordingly, more rubbish may be produced after people receive their orders. Additionally, the increasing number of delivery vehicles can cause more air pollution and carbon emissions. For example, when many customers order products separately, delivery workers have to make many trips to different places. This can increase the amount of fuel used and negatively affect the environment.

Regarding employment, online shopping can also change the types of jobs that are needed. To begin with, there will be more demand for delivery drivers, warehouse workers and customer service staff. Companies also need employees who have basic technology skills to manage websites, online orders and customer information. On the other hand, some traditional jobs may become less necessary. For instance, physical shops may need fewer workers because customers can purchase products online. As a result, some employees may have to learn new skills to adapt to changes in the job market.

To address this issue, several feasible measures can be taken. Companies should use environmentally friendly packaging and improve delivery systems to reduce unnecessary journeys. At the same time, workers should be provided with training in digital skills so that they can find suitable jobs in the future.

In conclusion, the rapid growth of online shopping can create more waste and pollution, while also changing employment opportunities. However, these negative effects can be minimized through better business practices and suitable training for workers.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết đủ độ dài, chia hai đoạn thân bài theo hai câu hỏi và nêu được rác bao bì, việc làm giao hàng cùng nhu cầu kỹ năng công nghệ. Tuy nhiên, đoạn môi trường bỏ hẳn khả năng giảm chuyến đi mua hàng và khí thải; chuỗi rác bao bì cũng chưa đi đến bãi chôn lấp và tác hại với sinh vật. reviews.question:
Some say that news has no connection with most people's lives, and it is a waste of time for most of us to read newspapers and watch television news programs.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, news plays an important role in providing information about events around the world. Despite the belief that news has little connection with people’s daily lives and that reading newspapers or watching television news is a waste of time, I believe that news is still useful for most people. This essay accordingly provides insights into the reasons for my opinion.

This situation has given rise to several reasons why some people consider news unnecessary. Firstly, many news stories are about events that happen far away from where people live. Accordingly, these stories may not have a direct effect on their daily lives. For example, people may spend time reading about political problems or accidents in another country even though these events do not affect them directly. Additionally, people are often busy with their studies, jobs and families. Therefore, they may think that spending time reading newspapers or watching television news is not useful.

However, I believe that following the news can bring several important benefits. To begin with, news helps people understand what is happening in their country and around the world. This information can help them make better decisions in their daily lives. For example, weather news can warn people about storms or heavy rain, allowing them to prepare before travelling. Another important point is that news can help people understand social problems. As a result, they may become more aware of issues in their communities and have a better understanding of other people’s lives.

To address this issue, people should choose reliable and useful sources of news instead of spending too much time on unnecessary stories. They can also spend a limited amount of time reading news every day.

In conclusion, although some news may not be directly connected to people’s lives, I disagree that reading newspapers and watching television news is a waste of time. News can provide useful information and help people understand important events around them.
reviews.overall: Em nêu rõ ý kiến không đồng tình với cả hai vế của đề và ví dụ tin cảnh báo bão đã cho thấy một lợi ích thực tế của việc theo dõi thời sự. Tuy nhiên, Body 1 lại giải thích vì sao tin tức không liên quan đến đời sống, trái với vai trò phải chứng minh sự liên quan ấy. Em cũng bỏ ví dụ bầu cử được giao và thêm một đoạn giải pháp ngoài dàn ý. Cô yêu cầu em viết lại Body 1 theo đủ chuỗi ví dụ đã học, giữ Body 2 tập trung vào lợi ích cảnh báo và nộp lại bài.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
Nowadays, news plays an important role in informing people about events around the world. Some people regard news as unrelated to most people's everyday lives and consider reading newspapers or watching television news a poor use of time. I disagree with both claims because even distant events can affect ordinary people and news can help them prepare for risks.

News that initially seems remote can still affect people's lives in meaningful ways. The 2020 United States presidential election, for instance, might have appeared to have little relevance to a Vietnamese reader. However, the result could shape future policies towards China. Trade tensions during Trump's presidency may have weakened China's economy and influenced its actions in the South China Sea. If he were reelected, some Vietnamese readers might hope that continued pressure would curb aggressive actions there. These possible effects on regional security show why it would be unreasonable to treat international news as fundamentally disconnected from life in Vietnam.

It is also wrong to assume that reading newspapers or watching television news is necessarily a waste of time. News coverage can alert people to existing or approaching problems in their communities, enabling them to respond before those problems cause harm. For example, weather news can warn residents about an approaching storm or heavy rain. They may then change their travel plans and prepare their homes, which can reduce their exposure to danger. Coverage of crime or political corruption can likewise make communities more aware of risks that require attention. Because the information can lead to practical precautions, the time spent following such news has a clear purpose.

In conclusion, news can have an indirect connection to people's lives even when the events reported occur far away. It can also warn them of dangers close to home. I therefore disagree that reading newspapers and watching television news is generally a waste of time.

reviews.question:
Some people say we do not need printed newspaper anymore.
To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, printed newspapers are becoming less popular because people can get news from the Internet and social media. Despite the belief that printed newspapers are no longer necessary, I partly disagree with this opinion. This essay accordingly provides insights into the reasons for my view.

This situation has given rise to several reasons why people think printed newspapers are unnecessary. Firstly, online news is much faster and more convenient. People can use their phones to read the latest information at any time and in any place. Accordingly, they do not need to buy a newspaper every day. Additionally, online newspapers can provide videos, pictures and updates, which can make the news more interesting. Therefore, many young people prefer reading news online.

However, I believe that printed newspapers can still bring some important benefits. To begin with, they can provide reliable and well-organised information. Readers can spend more time focusing on an article instead of being distracted by social media notifications. For example, older people may prefer printed newspapers because they are familiar with this way of getting information. Another important point is that printed newspapers can be useful in places where people have limited access to the Internet. As a result, they can still play a role in providing information to some groups of people.

To address this issue, newspapers could combine printed and online versions to meet different readers’ needs. This would allow people to choose the most suitable way to receive news.

In conclusion, although online news is faster and more convenient, I do not completely agree that printed newspapers are no longer needed. They can still provide reliable information and be useful for certain groups of people.
reviews.overall: Em viết đủ 280 từ và diễn đạt khá rõ, nhưng bài đi ngược hướng đồng ý đã được giao: mở bài và kết bài đều cho rằng báo in vẫn cần thiết. Hai đoạn thân cũng đổi vai trò: em bảo vệ báo trực tuyến trước, rồi bảo vệ báo in, trong khi bài cần thừa nhận lợi ích báo in, phản biện và chứng minh lợi ích báo trực tuyến vượt trội. Cô yêu cầu em viết lại theo đúng hướng ấy, giải thích đủ các bước về độ tin cậy, khả năng tiếp cận, nguồn tin đa dạng và tin cập nhật tức thời.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
Digital reporting has led some people to argue that physical newspapers are no longer necessary. I agree with this view: although print still offers certain benefits, online news now serves readers more effectively.

Admittedly, some people believe that printed newspapers remain valuable. Unlike many online platforms, newspapers are required to follow strict journalistic standards and undergo careful fact-checking, allowing readers to trust what they read. Print can also help people who lack digital skills or Internet access stay informed about current affairs. Nevertheless, these advantages no longer make the printed format essential. Many reputable news organisations publish both online and offline editions, so the accuracy of a report depends on the outlet's editorial practices rather than on whether readers see it on paper or a screen. Moreover, digital literacy is increasing across age groups, while Internet connections and smart devices are becoming more affordable. This wider access weakens the claim that online news is inherently difficult to use or reach.

More importantly, the advantages of online newspapers far outweigh those of their printed counterparts. Digital platforms give readers access to a much wider range of sources. With a few screen touches, people can follow events around the world in different languages and from different perspectives; a physical newspaper cannot offer the same breadth because its pages and distribution are limited. Online platforms also update stories in real time. With the help of the Internet, breaking news can be reported instantly, allowing readers to obtain crucial information without delay. This speed is particularly valuable when a situation is developing rapidly and people need to know what is happening as it unfolds.

In conclusion, the reliability and accessibility of print deserve recognition, but these benefits are no longer tied to paper. Given the wider range of sources and immediate updates available online, I believe printed newspapers are no longer needed as a means of receiving news.

reviews.question:
With the rapid development of communication technology; e.g. smart phones, tablets and other mobile devices, some people believe that the disadvantages outweigh the advantages.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
With the rapid development of communication technology, such as smartphones, tablets, and other mobile devices, opinions are divided on whether this trend brings more drawbacks than benefits. I strongly believe that the advantages of these technological advancements significantly outweigh the disadvantages.
On the one hand, there are some reasons why people might view communication technology negatively. Excessive use of mobile devices can lead to a lack of face-to-face interaction, which may weaken social skills among young people. Additionally, staring at screens for long hours often results in health issues like eye strain, poor posture, and sleep disorders. Critics also argue that constant notifications can cause major distractions in studying and working environments, reducing overall productivity.
On the other hand, I would argue that the benefits of modern communication technology are far more significant. First and foremost, smartphones and tablets have bridged geographical gaps, allowing individuals to communicate instantly with friends, family, and colleagues anywhere in the world through calls, messaging apps, and video conferences. This seamless connectivity has transformed both education and employment, making remote working and online learning widely accessible. Furthermore, mobile devices serve as portable libraries and office tools, enabling users to access vast amounts of information, manage daily tasks, and update news on the go, which greatly saves time and enhances efficiency.
In conclusion, while the overuse of communication devices can cause certain drawbacks regarding social interaction and health, these issues can be easily managed. Therefore, I am convinced that the overall advantages of modern communication technology are much greater than its disadvantages.

reviews.question:
Some people think that the increasing use of computers and mobile phones for communication has a negative effect on young people’s reading and writing skills.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
In recent years, the widespread use of computers and mobile phones for communication has raised concerns among many people. Some argue that this trend has a detrimental impact on the reading and writing skills of the younger generation. I partially agree with this viewpoint because while digital communication can hinder formal writing abilities, it also offers new opportunities for reading and text-based engagement.
On the one hand, there are valid reasons why digital communication can negatively affect young people's language skills. First, the heavy reliance on text messaging, abbreviations, and emojis often leads to poor spelling and grammar in formal academic writing. Many students nowadays tend to use informal slang and short forms when composing essays or reports, which lowers their overall writing standards. Second, because online content is often consumed quickly in short snippets or videos, young people may lose their patience and concentration when reading long, complex books. This short attention span can severely damage their deep reading comprehension skills.
On the other hand, I believe that computers and mobile phones also bring significant benefits to language development. With the internet, youngsters have access to a massive amount of reading materials, ranging from e-books and news articles to educational blogs. This constant exposure to English or other languages can actually expand their vocabulary and improve general comprehension if they choose quality content. Furthermore, regular chatting and emailing encourage young people to write more frequently than previous generations did, which can enhance their basic expression and typing fluency.
In conclusion, while the overuse of digital communication devices can lead to sloppy writing habits and reduced attention spans for reading, it simultaneously provides vast resources for vocabulary growth and daily practice. Therefore, the impact depends largely on how young people balance their screen time.

reviews.question:
The Internet has transformed the way information is shared and consumed, but it has also created problems that did not exist before.
What are the most serious problems associated with the Internet and what are the possible solutions?
reviews.originalEssay:
The advent of the Internet has completely revolutionized how information is shared and consumed globally. However, this digital transformation has also brought about severe issues that were previously unknown to society. This essay will discuss the most pressing problems caused by the Internet and propose practical solutions to address them.
The most serious problem associated with the Internet is the rapid spread of fake news and misinformation. Anyone can easily publish false information online, and due to social media algorithms, unverified stories often spread much faster than facts. This can mislead the public, damage people's reputations, and even influence political elections. Another critical issue is cybercrime and privacy leakage. Hackers and online scammers frequently steal personal data, financial details, or passwords, leaving innocent users vulnerable to identity theft and financial loss.
To tackle these problems, both governments and individuals must take action. First, authorities should introduce stricter laws and regulations to penalize platforms and individuals that intentionally spread fake news or commit cybercrimes. Social media companies also need to invest more in advanced moderation tools and fact-checking teams to remove harmful or false content promptly. Second, internet users themselves must develop strong digital literacy. People should be educated from a young age to think critically, verify sources before sharing information online, and protect their personal data by using secure passwords and avoiding suspicious links.
In conclusion, while the Internet offers incredible benefits for accessing and sharing information, it simultaneously creates serious challenges such as misinformation and cyber threats. These issues can be effectively mitigated through a combination of strict government regulations, improved platform moderation, and better digital awareness among users.
reviews.overall: Em viết đủ 270 từ, trả lời cả hai câu hỏi và nối các ý khá rõ. Tuy nhiên, Body 1 thay vấn đề bắt nạt qua mạng bằng tội phạm mạng; phần thao túng thông tin cũng chưa có cơ chế và ví dụ Cô giao. Body 2 chuyển sang phạt và kiểm duyệt nội dung như một giải pháp chắc chắn, trong khi bài học yêu cầu phân tích vì sao cách này khó áp dụng và có thể hạn chế tự do ngôn luận. Cô yêu cầu em viết lại hai Body theo đúng các chuỗi ý và ví dụ đã học rồi nộp lại.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
The expansion of the Internet has reshaped how people exchange and obtain information, but it has also brought serious new problems. Two especially harmful ones are cyberbullying and the manipulation of online information. This essay will explain these problems and examine possible responses, including the limits of regulating online content.

The spread of the Internet has brought cyberbullying and manipulation in its wake. Initially, social media can be used to send lies and rumours about a person to thousands of users within moments. Because such attacks can follow victims wherever they go online, they may struggle to escape the harassment and suffer psychological distress. Furthermore, online content is often subject to limited regulation, which allows malicious users to exploit it to influence others. For example, Facebook advertising during Donald Trump's 2016 US presidential campaign illustrates how social media messages can be used to shape voters' opinions. The speed and reach of these messages make manipulation difficult to detect.

Several responses are possible, although the two problems require different approaches. First, awareness campaigns can draw attention to cyberbullying and the harm it causes. Celebrities trusted by the public could use their platforms to explain the psychological distress that bullied people endure, encouraging users to recognise such behaviour and support its victims. Second, manipulation is harder to address through legislation. Laws checking social media posts and adverts might themselves give authorities power to control what people see. Since judgements about illegal content are subjective, broad restrictions could also curtail freedom of speech. Regulation therefore requires caution and cannot be presented as a straightforward solution.

In conclusion, cyberbullying and manipulation are two serious problems associated with the Internet. Public awareness may help confront bullying, while attempts to regulate misleading content must account for the risk of restricting free expression.

criteria.title: Đúng đề và bám sát dàn ý Cô giao
evidence: The most serious problem associated with the Internet is the rapid spread of fake news and misinformation.
Another critical issue is cybercrime and privacy leakage.
First, authorities should introduce stricter laws and regulations to penalize platforms and individuals that intentionally spread fake news or commit cybercrimes.
criteria.comment: Em trả lời đúng dạng vấn đề–giải pháp nhưng thay bắt nạt qua mạng bằng tội phạm mạng và xem luật kiểm soát nội dung là cách giải quyết trực tiếp. Dàn ý Cô giao yêu cầu hai vấn đề bắt nạt qua mạng và thao túng thông tin, rồi xét giới hạn của luật đối với vấn đề thứ hai.
criteria.action: Viết lại hai Body theo đúng hai nhánh vấn đề và phần phản hồi tương ứng; giữ ví dụ bầu cử và cảnh báo về tự do ngôn luận.

criteria.title: Giải thích ý và phản biện
evidence: This can mislead the public, damage people's reputations, and even influence political elections.

People should be educated from a young age to think critically, verify sources before sharing information online, and protect their personal data by using secure passwords and avoiding suspicious links.
criteria.comment: Em có chuỗi nguyên nhân–hậu quả cho tin giả và an toàn dữ liệu, nhưng chưa giải thích vì sao nạn nhân khó thoát khỏi bắt nạt qua mạng, cũng chưa nối việc thiếu kiểm soát thông tin với sự thao túng qua ví dụ cụ thể. Giải pháp giáo dục của em chưa hướng vào tổn thương tâm lý của người bị bắt nạt.
criteria.action: Bổ sung cơ chế lan truyền lời đồn, tác động liên tục lên nạn nhân, ví dụ quảng cáo trên Facebook trong cuộc bầu cử Mỹ, và chiến dịch nâng cao nhận thức với người nổi tiếng.

criteria.comment: Em dùng cụm V-ing chỉ kết quả ở câu về mất dữ liệu đúng chức năng. Riêng mở bài giữ nguyên cụm “information is shared and consumed” từ đề; em cần diễn đạt lại ý này bằng cách đổi cả cấu trúc câu, không chỉ thêm “globally”.
criteria.action: Đổi thành “how people exchange and obtain information” hoặc một cách tương đương giữ đúng nghĩa.

evidence: Another critical issue is cybercrime and privacy leakage.

criteria.title: Viết chính xác và tự soát bài
evidence: Hackers and online scammers frequently steal personal data, financial details, or passwords, leaving innocent users vulnerable to identity theft and financial loss.
criteria.comment: Các câu trong bài nhìn chung đúng ngữ pháp; cụm V-ing “leaving…” gắn đúng kết quả của hành động trước. Vấn đề chính là chọn và phát triển ý theo bài học, không phải lỗi chia động từ.
